title: Two Mining Laser IIs in the two utility slots of a Threshold carrying one Laser II or no laser, at Ironlight Crossroads, pulse laser stripped
note: Written by Zero, 2026-11-23 08:49 UTC (orders ENT-081, block ZERO: strip off-role pulse lasers, batch-upgrade to Laser II/III (rules F17, F37: dominant fits in parallel batches, measured in flight). The game sums the power of every fitted mining module (game/rules/07-economy.md, miner guide: beam power is the sum of every fitted mining module).) 5 Voidborn miners carry one Laser II and an empty second slot, one carries no mining module at all (table ship_modules 08:43 UTC). Ironlight asks 2,404 x 20. count 2: the runner buys and fits until two stand. min_credits 15,000: a bare hull buys two (F7). Empty hold, lawless (F3).
